Chapter 6126: Forces

Chapter 6126: Forces

Nevertheless, Ghost Ancestor’s ability impressed the crowd. First, he borrowed the power of the heavenly scripture to condense a primal anima. When his body couldn’t handle the newfound power, he used the market’s laws to keep everything together.

Others couldn’t fathom such a method yet he seemed to be pulling it off.

“Did he figure out everything regarding the market?” An ancestor wondered.

“I don’t think so, but he had met an immortal before.” A desolate god shook her head.

“The immortal that descended here, if that’s the case, it would make sense.” Another said.

“Then a second primal ancestor is coming to Sin then.” A spectator added.

However, the dao platform had numerous cracks, only increasing in quantity and size.

“The dao platform can’t take it.” Fog Emissary said with a serious expression.

“Sir, this is Ghostlaw Platform, it is also the Ghost Monarch’s platform.” Water Emissary told Li Qiye.

“If you wish to meet Ghost Monarch, you will have to use this platform. Ghost Monarch can’t appear again after the injuries.” The bald old man said.

“I don’t need this, a forceful summon works too.” Li Qiye smiled.

The group became startled and hurriedly said: “Sir, if you draw out the laws by force, the ghost market will cease to exist.”

“We won’t last in that case.” The bald man shook his head.

“Please show mercy, Sir.” Fog bowed.

“I enjoy being a ghost, this is my home.” Water said.

“What can I do if you all like this place so much? Guess someone else has to be the unlucky guy.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

They heaved a sigh of relief. They weren’t afraid of Specter Ancestor and only worried about Li Qiye disturbing the laws of the market. If he were to pull them out by force, that would put an end to everything.

Therefore, Specter Ancestor was a necessary casualty.

“Boom!” Waves of primal affinity surged outward as Specter Ancestor was one step away from this level.

Imperial-level characters were instantly suppressed, unable to breathe normally.

“It’s happening!” Someone shouted as his anima was fusing with the heavenly maelstrom.

“Rumble!” Layers of dao defense were erected around Ghostway Temple, sealing everything within. Their creator was an apex emperor.

“Get close and you will die.” A woman uttered coldly. She was at the age of a grandma but her life force remained ample. She wore a dragon robe and gazed at the crowd to intimidate them.

“Ghostmatron Emperor!” Many recognized her - the strongest emperor of Phantom with a deadly gaze.

Although she wasn’t the strongest emperor, she might be the cruelest. According to the tales, she married Phantom Emissary Grand Emperor’s son. However, to boost his cultivation, he refined her entire clan and she was the sole survivor.

Later on, she used an unknown method to become an emperor and refined his dynasty for revenge. She didn’t immediately kill him but used a blood art to torture him for ten thousand years. His agonizing screams traumatized listeners permanently.

Another two emperors joined her - a centaur and a demon.

The centaur was a female with a beautiful upper half - tall and slender with no lack of curves. She radiated beauty like a blossoming flower, especially the blue hair draping on her shoulders.

However, a chilling aura prevented anyone from getting close since it would freeze them instantly.

“Hoarfrost Emperor!” She was a sight to behold since centaurs were rarely, let alone one cultivating the ice dao.

She was born with a special physique in harmony with the ice dao, different from her kind. It helped her create a special dao and become an emperor with eleven fruits.

The other emperor was as large as a statue, casting a large shadow over the field. He held an illuminating torch, allowing others to see him.

He was as solid as a rock but wasn’t a golem. Wisps of mist emanated from him and coalesced into an expanse above him. His aura was far more potent than Hoarfrost Emperor.

“Lightwatch Emperor, Specter Ancestor’s disciple.” Many saw his gigantic frame for the first time.
